identity.title: Re-run EverRun dogfood across the hardened Ailuros boundary

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Use the same real EverRun evidence sample that exposed run-wide false positives to prove the full 8052-8063 boundary chain: explicit scope preservation, scoped governance records/signals, multi-scope outcome, temporal attribution, provenance precision, and producer-neutral conformance. Record fixed, still-open, expected-unknown, and new gaps without implementing new capabilities in this pack.
human_pressure.why_now: The boundary is only credible if the production evidence that motivated it proves the repaired semantics end-to-end.
do_not_misread: Do not replace the original run/sample to make the result cleaner.
Do not add new governance features while doing acceptance.
Do not treat all source-preserved unknown events as failures.
red_lines: No rewriting human expected judgments to match implementation.

machine_core.goal: Re-run the bounded real EverRun dogfood evidence after 8052-8063 and produce a final convergence record for the external governed-execution boundary.
red_lines: No sample replacement unless unavailability is explicitly documented.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Use the same run-20260822-180944 evidence sample where available, or document exact unavailability and equivalent evidence rationale before substitution.
Preserve native facts separately from Ailuros judgment and human expected judgment.
Different execution scopes do not create false decision conflict merely because their decisions differ.
A review-required scope prevents claiming the run is clean even when sibling scopes succeed.
Unknown evidence remains preserved and visible.
Every claimed fix cites evidence and the responsible pack.

producer.artifact: real EverRun evidence package previously exported from run-20260822-180944

observable_effect.assertion: The real multi-scope run is represented without cross-scope false positives while unresolved review and unknown governance facts remain visible and evidence-backed.

proofs.assertion: Dogfood acceptance records before/after classifications and repository validation passes with no production changes.

failure_semantics: Any new false positive is recorded as a regression.
Any unresolved false negative remains open and prevents complete convergence for that finding.
Expected unknown remains acceptable when evidence is genuinely insufficient.
Missing local source evidence is reported explicitly rather than reconstructed from memory.

steps.title: Re-run the original evidence sample
details: Use the same exported EverRun evidence package/run identifier used to expose the conflict issue.
Execute the production Ailuros evidence load/ingest/projection/signals/governed-result path.

steps.title: Verify scope semantics
details: Confirm sibling scopes with different decisions are not flagged as conflicts solely due to run-wide aggregation.
Confirm same-scope contradictions would still remain detectable if present.

steps.title: Verify governed result and provenance
details: Record lifecycle, native outcome, governed outcome, coverage, scoped signals, temporal attribution, and evidence refs.
Confirm review-required scope remains visible at aggregate outcome level.

steps.title: Classify convergence
details: For each prior finding, mark fixed, still-open, expected-unknown, or newly-discovered.
Map each fixed behavior to the responsible 8052-8063 pack and evidence reference.

steps.title: Seed only evidence-backed next work
details: List any remaining gaps as candidate future packs without implementing them here.

acceptance: The original real run/sample is re-evaluated after 8052-8063.
Cross-scope decision differences no longer produce the known false conflict.
Review-required scope prevents clean aggregate governance outcome.
Unknown evidence remains preserved and not promoted to clean.
Scoped signals and evidence provenance are inspectable.
No production or test files are modified.

must_check: Dependencies 8052 through 8063 are complete before acceptance.
The original dogfood sample is used or exact unavailability is documented.
Native facts, Ailuros judgment, and human expected judgment remain separate.
The known cross-scope false-positive class is demonstrably closed without suppressing true same-scope conflict semantics.
reject_if: The sample is cherry-picked or silently replaced.
Expected judgments are rewritten after seeing Ailuros output.
Raw .everrun/history or generated runtime artifacts are committed.
Unknown is presented as clean success.
New capabilities are implemented inside the acceptance pack.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: This is an end-to-end evidence acceptance pack with intentionally no code changes; the full suite plus documented dogfood replay is the required gate.
